async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Locate the searchbox and enter search query for author Eric and date 3/2
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search by message", exact=False)
    if await searchbox.count() > 0:
        # Assuming '3/2' means March 2, 2024; use GitLab search syntax
        await searchbox.fill("author:Eric after:2024-03-01 before:2024-03-03")
        await searchbox.press("Enter")
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        # Wait a bit for results to update
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    else:
        # If searchbox not found, try alternative
        searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox")
        if await searchbox.count() > 0:
            await searchbox.fill("author:Eric after:2024-03-01 before:2024-03-03")
            await searchbox.press("Enter")
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Step 2: Count the number of commits displayed after filtering
    # Look for commit items: in the accessibility tree, commits are links with commit messages
    # They are under the main section and have author links 'Eric Bailey'
    # Use a combination of roles to identify commit entries
    commit_count = 0
    # Method 1: Count links that are commit messages and have Eric Bailey as author
    # Get all links under main that might be commit messages
    main_section = page.get_by_role("main")
    commit_links = main_section.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text=lambda text: "commit" in text.lower() or text.strip())
    # Filter further by checking if nearby there is an author link 'Eric Bailey'
    # This is heuristic; for accuracy, we can count based on the structure
    # From the tree, each commit has a link with the commit message and a link 'Eric Bailey'
    # We can count the number of 'Eric Bailey' links that are associated with commits
    eric_links = main_section.get_by_role("link", name="Eric Bailey", exact=False)
    commit_count = await eric_links.count()
    
    # If no Eric links found, try alternative counting
    if commit_count == 0:
        # Count the commit message links that might be listed
        commit_message_links = main_section.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text=lambda text: len(text) > 10)  # Heuristic for commit messages
        commit_count = await commit_message_links.count()
    
    # Return the count as a string
    return str(commit_count)
